1.title: Jury Begins Deliberations in Lindsay Clancy Murder Trial
1.summary: In closing arguments, Ms. Clancy’s lawyer called her “a darn good mother.” The prosecutor accused her of “extreme atrocity and cruelty.”

2.title: DeSantis Administration Misspent $10 Million, Grand Jury Says
2.summary: A charity tied to Gov. Ron DeSantis’s wife received the money from a state Medicaid settlement and diverted it to political committees supporting a cause favored by the governor.

3.title: Trump Administration to Expand Deportation Flights to Haiti
3.summary: Flights to the Caribbean nation will increase from once a month to once a week now that the Supreme Court allowed President Trump to cancel a humanitarian program.

4.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Scour Remote Valleys, as Survivors Describe Families Swept Away
4.summary: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet in a massive flood. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

5.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
5.summary: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against  humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

6.title: Backing Off French Issue Could Restart U.S. Trade Talks, Canadian Official Says
6.summary: The minister in charge of trade with the United States was responding to comments by Jamieson Greer, the U.S. trade representative, to a Canadian broadcaster.
